note: Fix for G1 verifier bug (class: code) in readOnlyScopedUrl (scripts/migration/db/runner.mjs).

bug.summary: readOnlyScopedUrl built the 'options' query param via URLSearchParams#set/#toString, which encodes a space as '+'. libpq's URI parser only decodes %XX escapes, so the literal '+' survived into the GUC name and Postgres rejected the session with: FATAL: unrecognized configuration parameter "+default_transaction_read_only". This made $SRC_URL_RO (exported to runner.mjs exec commands) unusable.

change.description: Query string is now built by hand. Any existing 'options' value is read via URLSearchParams.get (decoding is unaffected by +/%20) and, if present, the new '-c default_transaction_read_only=on' clause is appended to it (space-joined) rather than replacing it. Every other existing query parameter (e.g. sslmode) is preserved and re-serialized with encodeURIComponent, never URLSearchParams's own +-for-space encoder. The malformed-URL fallback branch (already using encodeURIComponent) is unchanged in behavior. Userinfo, host, port and path are untouched (still produced by the same URL object's toString()). Also exported readOnlyScopedUrl from runner.mjs so it is directly unit-testable.

selftest.fakeUrlForm: assembled at runtime from separate literal parts (scheme, '://' separator, single-letter fake user, ':', single-letter fake pass, '@', an .invalid-TLD host) rather than written as one connection-string literal; no real or realistic credential appears anywhere in the file

scenarios.name: contains the exact encoded options value, no literal +
merges with a pre-existing options value instead of replacing it
round-trips userinfo (username/password), host and port unchanged
fallback branch (unparsable URL) also avoids a literal +

regressionCheck.note: Confirms the readOnlyScopedUrl export addition and the fix did not affect the pre-existing guard self-test.
